propositions: Jira issues moved between projects change their KEY but retain immutable numeric ID, causing bindings keyed on KEY to become unreachable when moved_issue_key table is not updated by third-party movers

Rebar bindings are pervasively keyed on mutable Jira KEY across get_jira_key, reverse index, note_absent, _retire, clear_absent, and set_last_get, so a moved issue silently detaches when the old key stops resolving
The fix additively captures and persists numeric jira_id alongside jira_key on every binding without changing the key-based store identity or affecting Cloud vendor behavior
On a key lookup miss, note_absent_or_rekey retries by recorded numeric ID and re-keys the binding to the issue's current key while updating the reverse index in the same operation
Legacy bindings without recorded jira_id continue working unchanged with no migration required, and the ID fallback does not fire when the key resolves normally
